data.name: NeuroDegen
data.shortDescription: Autonomous on-chain trading agent with commit–reveal execution on BNB Chain.
data.fullDescription:
NeuroDegen is an autonomous trading agent for BNB Chain that runs a commit–reveal execution loop. Every cycle, the agent commits to an intent hash on-chain before executing, then reveals the reasoning after settlement so trades are verifiable on Bsc Scan rather thanimplicitly trusted.

Use this skill when you want an agent to:
- Open/close leveraged perp positions on MYX using USDT collateral
- Bind a keccak256 reasoning hash to every trade
- Produce a per-trade proof page with oracle + ledger + reveal linked

Signing is delegated to the Purr-Fect Claw TEE wallet via the
`purr wallet` CLI, so private keys never leave the secure enclave.
The agent uses Pyth for prices, DGrid for the cognition gateway, and posts attestations to 0xe21f5ebec3f098c744c1e35db0c9338d6b717dc4.

Capabilities added to a host agent:
- quote(pair): live Pyth quote for BTC/ETH/BNB pairs
- plan(market, side): produce a reasoning hash + sized intent
- execute(intent): commit, execute via TEE signer, reveal

  - agent_status: report which vaults the agent manages

data.shortDescription: Autonomous DeFi protection agent — monitors internet shutdowns across 200 countries and auto-executes emergency exit plans through the TEE wallet before you lose access.
data.fullDescription:
DARKWATCH protects your crypto when your government kills the internet.

313 shutdowns hit 798 million people in 2025. $19.13 billion in crypto was liquidated in a single day — 70% in 40 minutes. 120 million crypto users live in shutdown-prone countries. Zero products protect them.

WHAT IT DOES:
- threat <country> — Real-time threat level with shutdown probability from OONI, IODA, CensoredPlanet, and Voidly's ML classifier (99.8% F1)
- scan — Rank all 200 countries by shutdown danger
- setup <country> — Create emergency exit plan (Venus Protocol withdrawal → PancakeSwap swap to USDT → cold wallet transfer)
- arm <plan-id> — Arm the plan for auto-execution when shutdown detected
- simulate <country> — Second-by-second timeline showing what happens with and without protection
- watch — Autonomous monitoring mode: detects shutdowns, auto-executes armed plans via TEE wallet
- heartbeat — Dead man's switch proof-of-life

WHEN TO USE:
- You hold DeFi positions (lending, LP, leverage) and live in or travel to countries with shutdown history
- You want autonomous protection that works while you sleep
- You need real-time censorship threat intelligence for any country
- You want to simulate what happens to your funds during a shutdown

TEE WALLET INTEGRATION:
Emergency plans execute through Purrfect Claw's TEE wallet. Private keys never leave the hardware enclave. Even the agent operator cannot access your funds. Transactions are signed inside the TEE and broadcast via MEV-protected RPC.

DATA: Powered by Voidly (voidly.ai) — 200 countries, 2.2B+ measurements, 46K evidence items, multi-source correlation (OONI + IODA + CensoredPlanet + Voidly Network).

data.name: Exposing Whale Dumping
data.shortDescription: Enter contract address to detect large-scale whale movements in one click.
data.fullDescription:
Whale Selling Detector SKILL — User Guide 🦞
One-Click Whale Tracking — Enter a token contract address to analyze exchange volume distribution, large on-chain transactions, and fund flows.
------------------------------


Zero configuration required. No API Key needed.

# ETH
python detect.py --chain eth --token CONTRACT_ADDRESS
# BSC
python detect.py --chain bsc --token CONTRACT_ADDRESS
# Solana
python detect.py --chain sol --token CONTRACT_ADDRESS

## Output Explanation
The report consists of four sections:
## 1. Rating

* ✅ NORMAL — Healthy
* [!] WATCH — Minor anomalies
* [!] CAUTION — Selling signals detected
* 🚨 SELLING — Active selling detected
* 🚨 DUMPING — Market dumping in progress

## 2. Anomalous Records
Large on-chain transfers with destination tags:

* [Preparing to Cash Out] → Transferred to an Exchange
* [Deflationary Benefit] → Transferred to a Burn Address
* [Liquidity Operation] → Transferred to a DEX Router
* [Internal Consolidation / Pending Observation] → Transferred to an Unknown Wallet

## 3. Behavioral Characterization
Comprehensive analysis of fund accumulation intent.
## 4. Trading Volume Ranking
Top 3 volume rankings across Binance, OKX, and Bybit.
## Optional: Deep Analysis

python detect.py --chain eth --token CONTRACT_ADDRESS --etherscan-key YOUR_KEY

Provide an API Key to enable deployer analysis, router transactions, and LP operations.
Supported Chains: ETH · BSC · Solana
⚠️ Note: Designed for tokens already listed on mainstream exchanges. Not suitable for unlisted meme coins.

data.name: fourmm
data.shortDescription: fourMM is a command-line tool for running market-making strategies on Four.meme tokens on BNB Smart Chain, designed to be driven by AI agents (Claude Code, MCP clients) or used directly.
data.fullDescription:
fourMM is a command-line tool for running market-making strategies on Four.meme tokens on BNB Smart Chain, designed to be driven by AI agents (Claude Code, MCP clients) or used directly.

Key Features
Flashbot Bundle Execution — Pump/dump commands sign all wallets' txs offline and submit via eth_sendBundle (BlockRazor), atomically executing in the same block. No MEV, no sandwich.
Atomic Router Contract — A Solidity router on BSC does buy + sell round-trip in a single tx (volume()), buy for another wallet (turnover()), and PancakeSwap round-trip (volumePancake()).
Bonding Curve + PancakeSwap Auto-Routing — Every trade command detects whether the token has graduated and routes through the correct contract. Your volume bot doesn't break at graduation.
Token Creation — Full Four.meme REST API integration: auth, image upload, token registration, on-chain createToken, optional dev-buy.
Refuses TaxToken / X Mode — Because the round-trip math doesn't work. fourMM knows what real market making means.
